summary: Established support-sensitive integer normalization and fixed-flow paired-mass retention, plus a conditional capacity-1 composition. Full nonuniform rounding remains unproved. No candidate or manuscript; source unchanged.
next_test: Prove or falsify interface NR by reconstructing CKS2013 Lemmas 3.11–3.14 for nonuniform owned masses, shared cluster vertices and bridges, with constant cardinality retention and polynomial rational arithmetic; then compose the algorithm and assess whether its delta is substantive rather than routine.
